concerns.text: Task T004 builds the Intent Graph using ground‑truth intents when they are available (`... using intents from the normalized trace (ground‑truth when available, otherwise inferred) ...`). This directly violates FR‑009, which mandates that graph construction must be performed **without** any ground‑truth hidden‑intent labels.

Task T005 measures computational cost with a conditional CUDA path (`torch.cuda.is_available()` fallback to CPU). Introducing a GPU code path breaches the project’s CPU‑only constraint (Constitution III) and creates nondeterministic behavior across runners.
